locations.note: The hunt for Elizabeth Bartley opens in the crumbling ruins of Castle Dracula.
John Morris and Eric Lecarde fight through the drowned Shrine of Atlantis, a mythic ruin placed in Greece.
The hunters climb the Leaning Tower of Pisa, its floors tilting as they go.
In a German munitions factory the hunters fight through furnaces, gears and machinery.
Drolta's monsters overrun the halls and fountain gardens of the Palace of Versailles.
The hunt ends at Castle Proserpina in England, where Elizabeth Bartley tries to raise Dracula.

routes.name: John Morris and Eric Lecarde
routes.note: Two vampire hunters chase Elizabeth Bartley across wartime Europe, from the ruins of Castle Dracula in Romania through a drowned Greek shrine, Pisa's tower, a German arms works and Versailles to Castle Proserpina in England.
